storyboard.premise: The ledger URL an agent would read the wall from is unset in this build — no dev, no prod Convex.
storyboard.question: Does the wall degrade to the committed snapshot file honestly, or does it hang, blank, or lie about where its data came from?
storyboard.axis: ledger-backed snapshot (production) vs file-fallback snapshot (this preview, no ledger URL at all)
storyboard.conflict: no VITE_CONVEX_URL — the exact condition an agent hits before any ledger is configured
storyboard.evidence: the wall root's own data-foyer-snapshot-source="file" attribute, and the same two machine-readable contract files production serves
storyboard.verdict: the wall renders the committed snapshot and says so on its own root node; /.well-known/agent-ui.json and /api/apps.json are still served from this build, unchanged
storyboard.exit: an agent with no ledger configured gets a working wall and an honest source attribute — never a blank screen or a silent lie

frames.caption: Picture an agent-workspace harness opening this build with no ledger URL configured: the wall falls back to the committed snapshot file, and says so on its own root node — not a blank screen, not a silent lie.
That agent fetches this fixed URL directly — no browser click, no ledger: the same build still serves its machine-readable contract file.
And the plain apps.json an agent-workspace harness already knows how to read, from the exact same build.
